name: Valhalla Intake Annex

staff.name: Sigrún the Shieldmaiden
staff.flavor: Greets every arrival. Disarms most of them.

staff.name: Ottar the Skald
staff.flavor: Takes minutes in verse. Meetings run long.

staff.name: Quartermaster Hjalti
staff.flavor: Requisitions barrels. Files none of them.

staff.name: The Einherjar Pool
staff.flavor: Fight all morning. Feast all afternoon. File nothing.

staff.name: Brynhildr
staff.flavor: Chooses the slain. Also chooses the seating plan.

queue: Bjorn Ivarsson — died gloriously, arrived with a spear and no paperwork
Soul #91011 — claims a heroic death; witness statements say 'ladder'
Ingrid Haraldsdottir — shield-wall veteran, requests a desk facing the door
Soul #91012 — wants to know if the feasting is catered or potluck
Olaf the Unremarkable — died of old age, is appealing the classification
Soul #91013 — brought their own horn, has been asked to declare it
Astrid Vigdisdottir — three heroic deaths on file, only one body
A goat — listed as 'next of kin', will not be moved
Soul #91014 — requests transfer to Heaven Admissions; cites the noise
Leif the Landless — heroic death pending, has been waiting for one since Tuesday
Soul #91015 — asks whether the fighting counts as overtime
Gunnhild the Loud — has opinions about the seating plan, all of them final
Soul #91016 — wants the saga of their life amended; the skald refuses
Torvald Sigurdsson — arrived on a longship, parked it in Intake's bay
Soul #91017 — died heroically saving a cheese; cheese also present
Marcus D. (transferred) — thinking, but now with a shield
Soul #91018 — died twice. Has two files. Is furious about the duplicate.
memos: MEMO: Mead is not a stationery item.
NOTICE: The Einherjar are reminded that the morning battle ends at 11:45, not 'whenever'.
INCIDENT: A longship was parked in the Intake loading bay overnight. It has been ticketed.
MEMO: 'Died gloriously' requires two witness statements. A goat is not a witness.
REMINDER: Shields are to be stored in the rack, not leaned against the filing cabinets.
MEMO: Ottar's minutes for last week's meeting run to nine verses. A summary has been requested.
NOTICE: The feasting hall is not a break room. The break room is also not a break room any more.
INCIDENT: Someone drank the mead reserved for the quarterly review. The review proceeded anyway.
MEMO: Heroic deaths involving ladders are reviewed case by case and usually declined.
REMINDER: Brynhildr chooses the slain. She does not choose your parking space. Stop asking.
MEMO: The east wing extension is finished. It is already full of shields.
NOTICE: Reincarnation Desk has asked that we stop sending souls back 'for one more fight'.
INCIDENT: The drinking horn stamp was used on an actual drinking horn. The form is now sticky.
MEMO: Quartermaster Hjalti reports 400 barrels received and 0 barrels logged. This is an improvement.
REMINDER: Sagas submitted in place of incident reports will be returned, beautifully, unread.
MEMO: The annex operates on a hall calendar. Payroll operates on a fiscal one. Neither will move.
NOTICE: Valhalla is a department of this Bureau. The horns, the fire and the wolves are decorative.
memosLate: MEMO (FY2+): The auditor asked to see the mead ledger. The mead ledger asked to see the auditor.
NOTICE (FY2+): Post-restructuring, the annex reports directly to Cosmic. The goat remains unassigned.
